app.name: Prayer Times
email.prayer_soon: The time for {{prayer}} is approaching — about {{mins}} minutes away.
email.prayer_passed: The time for {{prayer}} has now passed.
email.followup_nudge: No pressure — just a gentle check-in. Logging keeps your streak alive and helps your group.
email.followup.still_time: If the time for {{prayer}} has not ended, you can still pray — and if it has, make it up when it is easy. No blame; Allah's mercy is wider than any missed prayer.
email.tap_to_log: Tap a button to log it (this links straight to your account):
email.footer_hint: You can change these reminders any time from your notifications page.
email.footer_sent_with: Sent with care for your ṣalāh.
email.ayyam.body: Today is the {{hday}} of {{hmonth}} — one of the Ayyām al-Bīḍʿ (the 'white days'). The Prophet ﷺ loved to fast these middle days of each lunar month. A light, rewarding sunnah if you're able.
email.suhoor.body: Suhoor is blessed — leave a little time before imsak at {{imsak}}. Drink, eat, and make intention for the fast.
email.iftar.body: Iftar is at Maghrib ({{maghrib}}). Break your fast with dates and water, and remember: the duʿāʾ of a fasting person at ifṭār is not refused.
email.taraweeh.body: Isha is at {{isha}} — Taraweeh follows. Even a short prayer at home counts. May Allah accept it from you.
